item.title: commandline: Building modern agentic applications with Microsoft Copilot SDK 2.0
item.description:
Microsoft Copilot SDK 2.0 adds runtime enhancements for multi-tenant, high-performance agentic applications. The post focuses on helping developers choose an architecture that fits their agentic use case.
